title: Complex Financial Data Table
prompt: Build a compact report table with a caption, row and column headers, and explicit header associations if needed.
objective: Use semantic groups and make each data cell’s header context understandable.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: header associations, captions, grouping.
hints: Do not use color alone to communicate meaning; keep the relationships understandable in the markup.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.
